notes.title: Containment Search - Factory Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello, as promised the Rework of the Game is now out[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/960e653b48ed5c763ece531332e8d99222c6d8f9.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] A complete recode of the entire game

[*] A complete rework of the Map

[*] A complete rework of all Mechanics

[*] Reworked Graphics and Performance
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/74ce89c8c095e04667682141b87b9dd3fcb2e4b3.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Mechanics[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Lockers have been added

[*] Generator has been reworked

[*] Gas Mechanic has been added

[*] Key card Mechanic has been reworked

[*] Garages have been reworked

[*] Authorization Mechanic has been added
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/6eb51311f3a83391b7283b88b64bcf032afa67b4.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]Changes[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] GPS has been removed

[*] Lidar has been removed

[*] Flashlight has been added

[*] Updated to Unity 2022
[/list]

[i]The Reason for this is due to difficulties during development, these items will most likely see a use in other games[/i]

[b]We hope you enjoy the game as we do programming them[/b]

Best Regards,
Corebeast Interactive

notes.title: Containment Search Reloaded
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/e96b6ccb36bec06d7222d618bc409b106cb90d18.png[/img]


[b]Hello again,[/b] as indicated in the Q&A written at the 6th of August 2023, we scheudled an Remake of Containment Search. As of today we are finally able to share some insight into the games future. Please be aware that all showed pictures and surroundings are subject to changes.





[b]Containment Area:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/901f653518ca8d5cf315fd6081644b7a42b8ad2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/35c1dc040699b8b8981c6d6e556e5fb100cef7d2.png[/img]
[i][b]Dynamic textures, Random based objects and always changing gameplay.[/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/5712ea396245cdff01a8ea9704867d28b8003a9c.png[/img]
[i][b]Reworked Garages and lightning.[/b][/i]


[b]Tutorial Area:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/0ec305a7603f2c1a6f543e337a0b4dbea0901d35.png[/img]
[i][b]The Reworked Game will also contain new items and new concepts.[/b][/i]


[b]Equipment[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773125/0d6f6a60d7ddc878c0bb529554b20a709d05f256.png[/img]
[i][b]New Items Featuring[/b][/i]
[olist]
[*] GPS Localizer
[*] Lidar Scanner
[*] more...
[/olist]


[u]We think, we will be able to release arround next month.[/u]



[i]Stay tuned for that,[/i]
[b]Corebeast Interactive[/b]
